label: organization located or based in
definition: Organization 1 is based in or has an office/site in geographic place 2.
scope_notes: Firm/company-in, based-in, headquarters-in and geographic noun compounds qualify. Nationality adjective alone is ambiguous between ownership/origin and actual base. A sector, parent company or person is not a geographic place.

facts.reason: Internet is an industry/medium in these firm and traffic compounds, not a geographic base for Jupiter Media Metrix.
Yankee Group is explicitly a firm/company in Boston and research based in Boston.
T. Rowe Price is explicitly a company in and based in Baltimore.
Bernanke is a person linked by chairman/head roles to the Federal Reserve, not an organization geographically based in it.
Morningstar is explicitly a publisher/company/group in Chicago.
